以下是合成数学示例数据：`a`、`b`、采样点与结果都由界面在本地实时计算，并非真实测量数据。切换“使用偏移 b”后，`b` 输入框会隐藏，此时公式按 `y = a·x` 计算。

```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[form,result,chart,table,ask,reset])
$a: number = 5
$b: number = 1
$useOffset: boolean = true
let yAt5 = $a * 5 + ($useOffset ? $b : 0)
let points = @sample(x => $a * x + ($useOffset ? $b : 0), 0, 5, 6)
form = Form(children=[aInput,bInput,toggle], title="合成示例参数")
aInput = Slider(label="系数 a", bind=$a, min=0, max=10, step=1)
bInput = NumberField(label="偏移 b", bind=$b, visible=$useOffset, required=true)
toggle = Switch(label="使用偏移 b", bind=$useOffset)
result = Metric(label="x = 5 时的 y", value=yAt5, unit="u")
chart = Chart(kind="line", data=points, x="x", y=["y"], title="合成数学示例：y = a·x + (useOffset ? b : 0)", unit="u", xLabel="x", yLabel="y")
table = DataTable(data=points, rowKey="x", columns=[{"key":"x","label":"x"},{"key":"y","label":"y"}])
ask = Button(label="生成参数解释草稿", form=form, action=Ask(text="请解释这些合成数学示例参数及其结果。", context={"a":$a,"b":$b,"useOffset":$useOffset,"yAt5":yAt5}))
reset = Button(label="本地重置", action=Reset())
```

“生成参数解释草稿”只会在聊天输入框中生成一份可编辑草稿，不会自动发送。
